title: Forgetting inverse transposition on native representatives
statement: Fix the tensor presentation N of [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-presentation] for the closed structures S,W and tensor comparison t, together with native adjunction normalization hW and a Hom comparison χ satisfying NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility. If P,Q are NativeTensorKFlat and I is K-injective, then for every chain map φ:Q→Hom(P,I), put f=Q(φ);M.weilRepresentatives.model(P,I).inv. Forgetting the inverse W-transpose of f equals t at (Q(Q),Q(P)) followed by the inverse S-transpose of F(f);χ at (Q(P),Q(I)). This asserts compatibility on specified representatives, not existence of a closed structure or evaluation on all derived objects.

proof.text: Apply the Hom comparison square for an unrestricted source to P,I, obtaining a projection-normalized chain isomorphism c and K-injectivity of UI. Normalize φ by hW and its forgotten curried map Uφ;c by N.ordinaryNormalization.

source.place: Native tensor model, evaluation compatibility in step 3; Stacks 08J9, 0A97; ringed_forget_normalized_uncurry

proof.text: On each ordinary (p,q) tensor summand, N.chain_summand identifies composition with N.chain.inv with N.underived.inv followed by the forgotten native inclusion. The projection equation for c and N.underived_uncurry identify the two uncurried component maps. The coproduct universal property yields equality of the total chain maps. Localize and paste the Hom square, the two normalization equations, and N.model_forget. Naturality of inverse transposition under the localization factorization gives the required equality.

theorem native_weil_representative_uncurry
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (W : CoefficientClosedStructure M.weilHom)
    (t : W.tensor ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor)
    (N : NativeWeilTensorPresentation k₀ l X M S W.monoidal t)
    (hW : NativeAdjunctionNormalization (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) N.tensor
      (fun P ↦ N.adjunction.adj P) M.weilHom M.weilRepresentatives W
      (NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X N.tensor) N.model)
    (χ : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hχ : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) χ)
    (P Q I : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
    (hP : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X N.tensor P)
    (hQ : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X N.tensor Q) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (φ : Q ⟶ CochainComplex.bifunctorHomObj (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) P I) :
    let f := DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫ (M.weilRepresentatives.model P I hI).inv
    (nativeForget k₀ l X).map
        ((W.transpose (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).symm f) =
      t.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (S.transpose ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q))
          ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
          ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))).symm
          ((nativeForget k₀ l X).map f ≫
            χ.hom.app (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
